integrity: Analytical proof accompanied by independent exact-rational finite-case checker programs. This is a self-review rather than independent validation or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Single index case on a finite rooted tree, independent identically distributed vertex transmissibilities and conditionally independent outgoing contacts, fixed mean transmissibility 0<p<1; neither cyclic networks nor noisy observations nor fixed-mean-duration comparisons are claimed. The upper bound is a supremum among finite Poisson infectious durations. Some historical priority comparisons remain incomplete.
title: Convex ordering and sharp branching variance for SIR outbreaks on finite trees
